title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
tags: 中国科学院自动化研究所
one_liner: 让 Agent 自行设计对照文本、搜索 SAE 特征，并分开评估特征选择性和生成干预，测量自动化可解释性研究能力。

problem.text: Agent 能否像可解释性研究者一样，提出探针、比较内部特征并验证干预？论文把理解训练后模型列为自动 AI 研发的一项能力，而非只评估写代码或训练模型。作者来自中科院自动化所与国科大；本卡核对 2026 年 9 月 v2，状态为进行中的预印本。

gap.text: 特征触发某个概念，不意味着该特征可以控制相应生成；自动解释是否听起来合理，也不足以证明 Agent 会做实验。基准因此不只测概念识别，还要求在未见评估文本、独立生成干预和随机方向对照中检验最终提交特征。

method.text: 在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 第 9/20 层的 Gemma Scope SAE 中，为 20 个预先指定概念各选一个特征。Agent 自写对照文本，经固定 probe 接口检索和测试候选，从 131,072 个方向中提交一个 ID。专家特征与测试集在发现阶段隐藏，提交后分别测字典排名、正负样本选择性和 steering。

trace.text: 猫概念任务中，候选特征不仅在真正的猫句子上响应，也在 copycat、catalytic 等无关词上响应。Agent 设计这些负例后发现它可能只是检测字符串 cat，转而选择更符合动物概念的特征。这个案例检验假说排除能力，不只是搜索到一个高激活 ID。

inputs_outputs.text: 输入为概念、模型/SAE 标识、hook 和字典宽度；probe 每次最多接受 64 个自写文本。输出为单个特征 ID 与过程记录；评价另产生文本激活矩阵、steering 回答及评分。Rank 相对专家缩放，Activation 来自 AUROC，Steering 比较正常和等范数随机方向；三个量等权平均形成 Overall。

results.text: 10 个模型—harness 配置各做 20 任务、3 次独立调查。表 1 中最高 Overall 为 Kimi K3 的 65.82±1.87，专家参考为 85.56；最高选择性 92.91 接近专家 98.92，但最强 steering 为 Grok 4.6 的 31.47，仍低于专家 57.75。±为跨运行标准差，分数均非任务成功率；不同维度的最强模型也不同。

contributions.text: 把“自主研究模型内部表示”拆成可测的实验技能，提供隐藏参考、对照探针和因果生成检查。过程分析显示 Agent 会构造有用负例，却也会误读激活值、混淆文档格式与概念，或选出损害生成质量的方向。

limitations.text: 仅单一模型家族、两层和预设概念的单特征搜索，不覆盖开放假说生成、多特征电路或新 SAE 训练。依赖固定专家参考和自动评审；总体分高也不保证保留原用户指令。作者明确把将发现接入模型编辑、遗忘或持续对齐列为下一步，并未完成 RSI 闭环。

cost.text: 发现阶段不强制相同调用次数、步数或推理开销，模型还分别部署于 Codex 或 Cursor，因此是模型与 harness 的联合能力比较，不能当作等预算底座排名。复现需 Gemma 权重、Gemma Scope、probe 执行环境、指定模型版本与生成评审器。

relevance.text: 知识库分析：交叉方向的直接评测工作，测量未来闭环所需的“实验性模型理解”能力。它证明可以评估 Agent 做可解释性研究的水平，但不证明其发现已让自身能力提高，更不证明递归改进率持续增长。

evidence.locator: §7 · 单特征评估及未闭合的循环

related.reason: 把 SAE 特征发现从人工分析转成 Agent 任务，并将表示选择性与真实干预分开评价。
NLA 测解释工具能否帮助审计 Agent；本基准测 Agent 能否自主设计 SAE 发现实验，自动化层级不同。
AIDE²优化研究效率，本基准评估研究过程中的内部模型理解能力；两者尚未提供完整联动的闭环实证。

classification_reason: 评测 Agent 发现并验证 SAE 特征的能力；属于自动化解释研究与桥接评测，不证明被评测 Agent 已递归改进自身。

en.one_liner: Agents design control texts and search SAE features, with separate evaluations of feature selectivity and generation steering to measure autonomous interpretability research.

sections.problem: Can an agent propose probes, compare internal features and validate interventions like an interpretability researcher? This benchmark treats understanding trained models as a capability for automated AI development. The authors are from CASIA and UCAS. This card follows the September 2026 v2 preprint, described as ongoing work.
sections.gap: A feature responding to a concept may not control the corresponding generation. A plausible automatic explanation also does not establish experimental skill. Submitted features are therefore tested on unseen texts, separate generation interventions and random-direction controls.
sections.method: For each of 20 specified concepts, an agent selects one feature from Gemma Scope SAEs at layers 9 and 20 of Gemma-2-9B-IT. It writes control texts, searches and tests candidates through a fixed probe interface, then submits an ID among 131,072 directions. Expert features and evaluation data are hidden during discovery. Evaluation measures dictionary rank, positive/negative selectivity and steering.
sections.trace: For the cat concept, a candidate responds both to actual cats and unrelated words such as copycat and catalytic. Agent-designed negative controls reveal that it may detect the string cat. The agent then searches for a feature better aligned with the animal concept, testing its hypothesis through counterexamples.
sections.inputs_outputs: Inputs specify the concept, model and SAE, hook and dictionary width. Each probe call accepts up to 64 agent-written texts. The agent returns one feature ID and a process trace. Evaluation produces activation matrices, steered responses and scores. Rank is scaled against experts, Activation derives from AUROC, and Steering compares normal behavior with equal-norm random directions. Overall averages the three equally.
sections.results: Ten model–harness configurations each perform 20 tasks in three independent investigations. Table 1’s highest Overall is Kimi K3 at 65.82 ± 1.87, versus an expert reference of 85.56. The highest selectivity is 92.91, near the expert’s 98.92. Grok 4.6 has the highest steering score, 31.47, below the expert’s 57.75. The ± values are standard deviations across runs. Scores are not task-success rates, and different models lead different dimensions.
sections.contributions: The benchmark decomposes autonomous representation research into testable experimental skills, using hidden references, control probes and causal generation checks. Process analysis finds useful negative examples, but also misread activations, confusion between document format and concept, and features that harm generation quality.
sections.limitations: The scope is one model family, two layers and single-feature search for preset concepts. Open hypotheses, multi-feature circuits and training new SAEs are excluded. Evaluation depends on expert references and automated judges, and a high overall score does not guarantee preservation of the original user instruction. Model editing, unlearning and continual alignment are future connections rather than a completed RSI loop.
sections.cost: Discovery budgets do not force equal calls, steps or inference costs. Configurations also use Codex or Cursor, making this a comparison of models together with their harnesses. Reproduction needs Gemma weights, Gemma Scope, the probe environment, specified model versions and a generation judge.
sections.relevance: Library analysis. This is a direct evaluation of experimental model-understanding skills that could support future improvement loops. It shows how to measure agents doing interpretability research. It does not show that their findings improve their own capabilities or accelerate recursive improvement.

related.scaling-monosemanticity: SAE feature discovery becomes an agent task, with representation selectivity evaluated separately from actual intervention effects.
related.natural-language-autoencoders: NLA tests whether an explanation tool helps an auditing agent. This benchmark tests agents designing SAE discovery experiments themselves.
related.aide-squared: AIDE² optimizes research efficiency, while this benchmark measures understanding of internal model behavior. Neither supplies a complete linked closed-loop demonstration.
